feature: B+ addendum 10 · who sells the price on the public event page (/e/[id])
note: Boards: design/design_handoff_bplus_redesign/addendum-10/boards/01-public-resale (public-resale-cheapest, public-boxoffice-resale, public-resale-only at 360 and 1280; public-spec for case D and the Light tones). The public page sits behind the launch gate, so the pre-PR sheet runs the web dev server with NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_BROWSE=true on its command line. Each case needs an upcoming event in the target database: CC_SOLDBY_A_ID (cheapest price is resale, four other sellers, so Also shows 3 and +1 more), CC_SOLDBY_B_ID (box office headline with a resale alternate), CC_SOLDBY_C_ID (only resale listed), CC_SOLDBY_D_ID (a promoted sold-out report with box office and resale listed). The no-tier flat card and the Community pill are covered by PublicEventDetail.test.tsx.

rows.label: A: the cheapest price is resale; Resale pill, Sold by {seller} · resale, Also cheapest first, +1 more
B: box office headline; ★ Box office pill, face value, the resale price as an Also row with its pill
C: only resale is listed; the second resale seller under Also, then the dashed note
D: sold out leads; Resale from {price} on {seller} · above face value
